Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

One-dimensional crosscuts. Same material and section. Every millimetre accounted for.

Measure twice. Plan here.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

One-dimensional crosscuts. Same material and section. Every millimetre accounted for.

Measure twice. Plan here.

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

One-dimensional crosscuts. Same material and section. Every millimetre accounted for.

Measure twice. Plan here.

A NOTE ABOUT THIS WORKSHOP

Illustrative sample measurements are loaded. Replace them with your actual usable stock and cut list. Plans and approvals last only for this page session.

6 native WebMCP tools registered in this document. Your browser agent can discover them.

There is no built-in chat or simulated agent here. Offcut has no backend, does not call a model and needs no API key. Your real browser agent lives outside this website. When you ask it to, it can read your measurements through native WebMCP under its provider's terms.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

Measure twice. Plan here.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

Measure twice. Plan here.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

One-dimensional crosscuts. Same material and section. Every millimetre accounted for.

Measure twice. Plan here.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

Native WebMCP ready

6 native WebMCP tools registered in this document. Your browser agent can discover them.

There is no built-in chat or simulated agent here. Offcut has no backend, does not call a model and needs no API key. Your real browser agent lives outside this website. When you ask it to, it can read your measurements through native WebMCP under its provider's terms.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

One-dimensional crosscuts. Same material and section. Every millimetre accounted for.

Measure twice. Plan here.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.

A cutting-stock workbench for small workshops. Measure your stock, compare real arrangements, and make the final call.

One-dimensional crosscuts. Same material and section. Every millimetre accounted for.

Measure twice. Plan here.

FOR THE LENGTHS ALREADY ON YOUR RACK

Good cuts.
Less guesswork.
